limits: Original constructor and bitmap copy execute; glyph-index and FT_Load_Glyph providers explicitly supplied with successful return codes. Native FreeType hinting/compiler configuration and actual original bitmaps not qualified.

Constructor loads flags0 and signed-shifts26.6 metrics. Bitmap copy loads flags4, copies each coverage byte into all four RGBA channels, uses signed bitmap pitch and clamps vertical bearing offset to zero.
This does not qualify cache allocation, other bitmap paths, errors, GPU atlas composition, drawing, text layout or complete HUD.
